sources.locator: Title search: 时间型一次性密码

statement.zh: **术语**：时间型一次性密码（TOTP）。RFC 6238 把 TOTP 定义为「extension of the… HMAC-based One-Time Password (HOTP) algorithm, as defined in [RFC4226], to support the time-based moving factor」，并要求「The algorithm MUST use HOTP [RFC4226] as a key building block」。核心关系是「TOTP = HOTP(K, T)」，其中「T = (Current Unix time - T0) / X, where the default floor function is used」；X 是以秒为单位的时间步（默认 30 秒），T0 是开始计步的 Unix 时间（默认 0，即纪元）。
statement.en: **Term**: TOTP.It is registered under protocols and PKI, applied security engineering.

statement.zh: 把移动因子换成时间，双方无需同步计数器，但代价是必须容忍时钟偏差。§5.2 建议「at most one time step is allowed as the network delay」，并推荐 30 秒的时间步作为「a balance between security and usability」。§1.2 说明默认构造基于 HMAC-SHA-1（RFC 2104），同时允许「MAY use HMAC-SHA-256 or HMAC-SHA-512 functions … instead of the HMAC-SHA-1 function」。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in protocols and PKI, applied security engineering, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 实现要求为每个证明者使用唯一密钥：「There MUST be a unique secret (key) for each prover」，密钥「SHOULD be randomly generated or derived using key derivation algorithms」，密钥库「The key store MUST be in a secure area」，通信「SHOULD take place over a secure channel, e.g., … (SSL/TLS)」。§4.2 还要求实现「MUST support a time value T larger than a 32-bit integer when it is beyond the year 2038」。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: 强度来自底层 HOTP：§5.1 说「The security and strength of this algorithm depend on the properties of the underlying building block HOTP」，而 HOTP 的构造基于 HMAC 与 SHA-1；同一节也认为「the best possible attack against the HOTP function is the brute force attack」。时间窗口带来额外暴露：§5.2 警告「When an OTP is generated and exposed to a third party before it is consumed, the third party can consume the OTP within the time-step window」，因此要求「The verifier MUST NOT accept the second attempt of the OTP after the successful validation」以保证一次性使用。§6 给出偏差上限：接受两个时间步回退时，最大时间漂移约 89 秒。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh: RFC 6238「TOTP: Time-Based One-Time Password Algorithm」由 M’Raihi、Machani、Pei 与 Rydell 撰写，2011 年 5 月发布，类别为 Informational，并自我说明「not an Internet Standards Track specification」；它构建在 2005 年标准化的 HOTP（RFC 4226）之上，把计数器替换为时间。
statement.en: Registered period: Web & Protocol Era, The Frontier.The exact date is left to the ledger; institutional placement and technical detail follow the cited sources.
